items.situation: student checking with TA about lab report requirements
items.speaker: I'm not sure what goes in the lab report.

options.A: Well, just summarize your results and method.
options.B: The report cards come out next week.
options.C: I already returned the library book.
options.D: Yes, the lab is on the second floor.

items.explanation: 说话者对实验报告该写什么感到困惑。A 以话语标记 Well 开头，直接给出实用建议（写结果和方法），是自然的间接回应，正确。B 复用了 report 一词但指向完全不同的“成绩单”，属语义联想陷阱。C 是语法正确但与话题无关的句子（还图书馆的书）。D 用 Yes 回答了一个并非是非问的陈述，且只说实验室位置，答非所问。

items.situation: student asking about gym or sports facility hours
items.speaker: Don't they keep the gym open pretty late?

options.A: The gym got new treadmills last week.
options.B: Actually, it closes at ten on weekdays.
options.C: I left my umbrella at home.
options.D: It's right next to the dining hall.

items.explanation: 说话者想知道健身房这么晚是否还开着。B 以 Actually 开头，间接给出关门时间，实际回答了对方的关切，正确。A 复用 gym 却在描述器材，没回答是否开门，属语义联想陷阱。C 是与语境无关的正常句子（把伞落家里了）。D 只回答了位置（在哪儿），而非是否营业，属答非所问。

items.speaker: I'm thinking about going home this weekend.

options.A: Home games are always on Saturdays.
options.B: The printer ran out of paper again.
options.C: Oh, when will you be back?
options.D: Yes, the weather looks nice today.

items.explanation: 室友说打算周末回家。C 用一个反问（你什么时候回来？）推进对话，是自然回应，正确。A 复用 home 但指向“主场比赛”，属语义联想陷阱。B 是与语境无关的句子（打印机没纸了）。D 用 Yes 回应一个非是非的陈述，且转向天气，属答非所问/误解。

items.situation: student seeking help at the writing center
items.speaker: Do you think you've got time for my intro?

options.B: The cafeteria closes early on Fridays.
options.C: It's on the third floor, actually.
options.D: Sure, which draft is this one?

items.explanation: 说话者在写作中心请人帮看引言。D 先答应（Sure），再用反问确认是哪一稿，推进对话，正确。A 复用 intro/introduce 但指向“互相介绍”，属语义联想陷阱。B 是与语境无关的句子（食堂周五早关门）。C 只给了地点（三楼），并未回应帮看的请求，属答非所问。

items.situation: two friends deciding where to get lunch
items.speaker: Where do you want to grab lunch today?

options.A: Let's try that new taco place.
options.B: The lunch specials are on the menu.
options.C: My phone battery is almost dead.
options.D: Around noon, if that works for you.

items.explanation: 说话者问在哪儿吃午饭。A 直接给出地点（那家新墨西哥卷店），正确。B 复用 lunch 却在说菜单特价，没回答去哪儿，属语义联想陷阱。C 是与语境无关的句子（手机快没电了）。D 回答的是时间（大约中午），而问的是地点，属答非所问。

items.situation: two classmates discussing a group project deadline
items.speaker: How are we finishing this if it's due Monday?

options.A: Mondays are always so busy for me.
options.B: Don't worry, I'll take the last section.
options.C: It started raining right after class.
options.D: Yes, we should definitely finish it soon.

items.explanation: 说话者担心项目周一前做不完。B 不直接回答“怎么做”，而是承担最后一部分来解决根本问题，属语境转移，正确。A 复用 Monday 却在抱怨周一忙，属语义联想陷阱。C 是与语境无关的句子（下课后下雨了）。D 用 Yes 回应了一个 How 问句，只是重申目标却没说“怎么做”，属答非所问。

items.situation: student checking lost-and-found at front desk
items.speaker: Why hasn't anyone turned in my backpack yet?

options.A: The straps on that backpack look sturdy.
options.B: I'm meeting my advisor at three.
options.D: Yes, the desk closes at six.

items.explanation: 说话者抱怨背包还没被交到失物招领处。C 用习惯性安慰语（这类东西一般都会出现的）自然回应，正确。A 复用 backpack 却在评价背包带子，属语义联想陷阱。B 是与语境无关的句子（三点见导师）。D 用 Yes 回应一个 Why 问句，只给了关门时间，属答非所问。

items.situation: student asking a professor about office hours or assignment
items.speaker: Don't you usually have office hours on Fridays?

options.A: The office supplies are in that closet.
options.B: The elevator's been broken all week.
options.C: It's due next Friday at noon.

items.explanation: 说话者确认教授周五是否有答疑时间。D 用习惯性欢迎语（当然，随时来）热情回应，正确。A 复用 office 却指“办公用品”，属语义联想陷阱。B 是与语境无关的句子（电梯坏了一周）。C 复用 Friday 却回答某作业的截止时间，并非是否有答疑，属答非所问。

items.situation: student asking about campus shuttle or parking
items.speaker: What's the deal with the shuttle being so late?

options.A: Your guess is as good as mine.
options.B: The shuttle has comfortable new seats.
options.C: I forgot to charge my laptop.
options.D: It stops right by the gym.

items.explanation: 说话者抱怨校车为何这么晚。A 用习惯用语（我也不清楚）自然回应，正确。B 复用 shuttle 却在夸座椅，没回应晚点，属语义联想陷阱。C 是与语境无关的句子（忘给笔记本充电）。D 回答的是校车停靠地点，而非晚点原因，属答非所问。

items.situation: classmate asking to borrow lecture notes
items.speaker: When can I get your notes from Tuesday?

options.A: The notes on the piano sounded off.
options.B: I'll just email them to you tonight.
options.C: My roommate adopted a cat last week.

items.explanation: 说话者问什么时候能拿到周二的笔记。B 不纠结于具体时间，而是直接提出今晚发邮件把笔记发过去，解决根本需求，属语境转移，正确。A 复用 notes 却指“钢琴音符”，属语义联想陷阱。C 是与语境无关的句子（室友领养了猫）。D 回答的是地点（教室里），而问的是时间，属答非所问。
